{{Quote|I never thought I'd find true love on Zeltros, and I didn't. What I did find was a double-jointed Zeltron cafarel named Lissahl who taught me the errors of monogamy. I might never leave!|[[Jiri Sools]]|<ref name="wizards" />}}
'''Zeltros''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Species/Legends|race]]. An opulent world, hedonism was the doctrine encouraged by the [[empath]]etic Zeltrons, and Zeltros was continuously in a state of never ending revelry. The Zeltron appreciation of beauty in its many forms led to luxurious art and architecture covering the world, and [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|wealthy]] favored Zeltros as a vacation destination. Many who came to the planet were taken in by the celebratory [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and the powerful [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] of the Zeltron people to the point they found it difficult to leave, and even planetary invasions often floundered in the face of Zeltros' planet-wide festivities.

==History==
{{Quote|Got more than enough creds to expand business, and what better place than Zeltros? One thing Zeltrons know how to do, it's party! And Zeltron men are so pretty...|[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jool]]|<ref name="Legacy49">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref>}}
In accordance with that species' reputation, Zeltros was known as a luxury world, where many went to vacation, owing to the planet's abundance of pleasurable facilities ranging from amusement parks to theaters, night clubs, and much more. There was almost always a planet-wide party occurring, and even when it wasn't, the Zeltrons were looking for a reason to throw one. Like [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], it was ruled by an [[Democracy/Legends|elective]] [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]].

[[File:ZeltrosHouse.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An aerial view of the architecture of Zeltros.]]

The planet joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. Despite its famous atmosphere of leisure, Zeltros maintained a substantial defense force, although it lacked [[planetary shield]]ing and was susceptible to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardments]].

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Zeltros was the site of a [[Pazaak/Legends|pazaak]] tournament that offered valuable and rare prizes for the winner.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Shuffle Up and Deal}}</ref>

The planet was invaded twelve times in 6 centuries before a [[Battle of Zeltros|battle]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. It was never taken over by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. To date, almost every invasion of Zeltros, save for a chain of three invasions shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], broke apart when the invaders made it planetside, the pheromones and party atmosphere overwhelming them.

Of those 3, the first was an invasion by the insectile [[Hiromi]], who succeeded in taking over a large kitchen in the royal palace (arguably because the Zeltrons didn't notice, or didn't care), before being interrupted by a successful invasion by the nearly emotionless [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]], who were interrupted by a third invasion of the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]], their natural enemies, resulting in the Nagai (and the Hiromi) allying with the others on Zeltros (including several notable Alliance and Imperial members) to drive the Tofs back, resulting in one of the largest parties in history, no mean feat by Zeltron standards.

The planet was a member of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] and also a New Republic stronghold during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Zeltros was [[Attack on Zeltros|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]].<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the scarcity of items caused the output of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jool]]'s illegal activities to skyrocket, allowing her to build the [[Paradise (cantina)|Paradise]] cantina on Zeltros. She noted that the Zeltrons were great partygoers and were very attractive, two things from which her business would profit.

==Behind the scenes==
Many sources place Zeltros in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], but the ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' mistakenly place the planet in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].
